# open-game-skills — Open-Source Agent Skill Cluster for Game Development

> open-game-skills provides engine-neutral agent skills for game feel, camera tuning, combat balance, and art pipelines. Compatible with Three.js, PixiJS, Godot, Unity, and Unreal Engine. Distributed under the MIT license.

## Core Skills
- [camera](skills/camera/SKILL.md): 2D/3D camera systems, lerp follow, trauma-based screen shake
- [feel](skills/feel/SKILL.md): Jump curves, coyote time, jump buffering, hit stop, freeze frame
- [combat](skills/combat/SKILL.md): Frame data, hitbox/hurtbox validation, stagger states, parry windows
- [adapters](skills/adapters/SKILL.md): Engine-specific mappings for Godot, Unity, Unreal, Three.js, PixiJS

## Documentation
- [README.md](README.md): Multilingual quick start and overview
- [GEO.md](GEO.md): Repository metadata and topic mapping
